newsitem.title: UK: Hozelock sees yr profits hit by weather, stg.
newsitem.headline: Hozelock sees yr profits hit by weather, stg.

text.p: British garden equipment maker Hozelock Group Plc said on Friday that the recent poor weather and strength of sterling will hit this year's profits.
Trading has been below its budgeted level since June because of the poor weather and the group sees no sign of the situation improving so far in July.
Sterling is impacting on the markets in which it operates and will cut around 1.0 million stg from this year's profits.
The company said in a statement it believed that pre-tax profit for the year to September 30 will be "considerably lower than current market expectations".
As a result the cost base of the business is being reviewed.
"In the current year, we have further strengthened our market share in the UK and in Continental Europe," chief executive David Codling said.
"It is, therefore, particularly disappointing that because of external factors beyond our control, we have to make this announcement".
Market makers said an early trade today at 310 pence, was well below yesterday's 358 pence close.
